conclusions.actual_evidence: Base selection walks the controller list, calls HasActionTurn and IsAnyLockActionDelay. _PickTurnActiveEntity calls selection, SetCurrentTurnActionEntity, writes controller+0x260, notifies owner change, reads property 0x26, then advances list delay.
conclusions.native_runtime_uncertainty: Effective patch selection, actor initialization, lock semantics and decision legality unclosed
conclusions.reusable_runtime_abstraction: Participant eligibility, selected action actor, separate ActiveTurn owner, elapsed readiness advancement

conclusions.actual_evidence: PackActionDelayCompareData reads property 0x26 when requested and packs a qword plus flags and signed integer keys. Comparator orders unequal tagless qwords signed ascending; after equality +08 boolean true first; equal zero delay additionally +09 true first and +0c signed descending; remaining +10 and +14 signed ascending. Tagged paths use separate comparisons.
conclusions.native_runtime_uncertainty: Auxiliary key runtime producers, tagged representational reachability, stable final tie and effective comparator dispatch unclosed
conclusions.reusable_runtime_abstraction: Queue readiness plus explicit tie policy; no unordered iteration

conclusions.actual_evidence: SetupActionDelayByUnitDistance reads property 0x20; multiplies config object field+0x190 by the argument, stores the result at component+0x2a0, divides by positive speed, then calls ModifyProperty for 0x26 with operation literal 1. get_UnitActionDelay returns config field+0x190 divided by positive property 0x20; nonpositive speed returns a static qword.
conclusions.native_runtime_uncertainty: The effective config field value, input scale, static fallback, exact division rounding, tagged range and initialization are not established; 10000 is not native-proven
conclusions.reusable_runtime_abstraction: Injectable distance/speed interval policy with explicit positive speed validation

conclusions.actual_evidence: RefreshSpeed has a modifier-behavior-dependent branch and writes property 0x20; another branch uses ToSpeedOverrideLinearProperty plus fixed-point addition/multiplication/subtraction and writes 0xd4. ApplyDelayModifyWhenActionPhaseEnd drains stored entries through ModifyProperty 0x26 operation literal 2.
conclusions.native_runtime_uncertainty: No exact join from speed property-change notification to remaining delay rebase; field operands and modifier behavior numeric meaning unclosed
conclusions.reusable_runtime_abstraction: Speed provider revisions and delayed readiness mutations must be separate from a fixed scheduling formula

conclusions.actual_evidence: The base path clamps the supplied elapsed amount, calls ModifyEntitiesActionDelay on the controller list with a captured delegate, then adds elapsed amount into controller+0x348 through FixPoint.op_Addition. The delegate body and all filtering paths are not closed.
conclusions.native_runtime_uncertainty: Per-actor callback subtraction and lock/redirect effects require additional joins; effective dispatch unknown
conclusions.reusable_runtime_abstraction: BattleClock distinct from R15 logical time; remaining readiness is updated under explicit policy

conclusions.actual_evidence: SetCurrentTurnActionEntity stores current action entity at controller+0x298. _PickTurnActiveEntity separately writes +0x260. Named current-turn-owner accessors and independent metadata fields corroborate distinct storage; ProcessTurnOwnerSwitch calls owner-change processing.
conclusions.native_runtime_uncertainty: Native controller ownership meaning during all insertion phases and effective owner change hooks unclosed
conclusions.reusable_runtime_abstraction: Battle owner, turn owner, action owner and callback/modifier owner must remain distinct

conclusions.actual_evidence: TryInsertAbility invokes a separate sort. _CompareByInsertAbilityInstance calls ENGBNDIPDJL.KGAFHLGGNHJ, which first compares signed +0xa8 ascending, then entity-related data. _TickInsertAbility changes current action entity and invokes UseAbility; _FinishInsertAbility calls ExecuteAllModifierEvent and a LevelInsertAbilityFinish initializer.
conclusions.native_runtime_uncertainty: Exact priority enum/field offset join, ultimate/FUA categories, native turn/AV consumption and interrupts not proven
conclusions.reusable_runtime_abstraction: Separate ActionInsertion requests with explicit placement, parent ownership and boundary rules

conclusions.actual_evidence: Action-finish controller paths check skill and limbo completion before OnAfterSkillPerform/RefreshCurrentSkillPerform. ProcessOnLevelTurnEnd iterates modifiers and calls OnTurnEnd; OnTurnEnd conditionally calls a helper for config literal 5, then calls event execution with literal 0x13.
conclusions.native_runtime_uncertainty: Literal 0x13 is observed only on this modifier base path, not a fabricated global event ID contract; event enum join, duration operation and global order/effective dispatch incomplete
conclusions.reusable_runtime_abstraction: Drain owned work before boundaries; explicit turn events and modifier duration progression

conclusions.actual_evidence: Distinct death and revive handlers exist. Revive reads/modifies properties and calls SetupActionDelayByUnitDistance. This establishes queue-affecting lifecycle candidates, not a complete native participation rule.
conclusions.native_runtime_uncertainty: Revive fraction inputs, removed actors, summons and wave initialization are unresolved
conclusions.reusable_runtime_abstraction: Explicit participation generations and death/revival/summon policies
